# Localization

> One place every user-facing string goes through (i18n).

- Package: `Localization` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Localization")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Localization")` on the client

## `Gaxia.Localization`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/Localization.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local Localization = Gaxia.Localization
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local Localization = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.Localization)
```

### Functions

- `Localization.Load(locale: string, entries: Catalog): ()`
  Merge entries into a locale's catalog (call repeatedly to extend).
- `Localization.SetLocale(locale: string): ()`
- `Localization.GetLocale(): string`
- `Localization.T(key: string, vars: { [string]: any }?): string`
  Translate `key` in the current locale (then default locale, then the key itself), interpolating {token} from `vars`.
- `Localization.Has(key: string): boolean`
  True if `key` exists in the current or default locale.
- `Localization.OnLocaleChanged(fn: (locale: string) -> ()): () -> ()`
  Returns an unsubscribe function.
